benchmark_scope: LOCAL_PIPELINE_MICROBENCHMARK_ONLY (NOT End-to-End Remote Desktop Network/NVENC Latency)
notes: Measures local CPU dirty-tile memory scan, HMAC signing, and 127.0.0.1 socket overhead ONLY. End-to-end Remote Desktop LAN/WAN + RTX 3060 NVENC latency requires 2-PC Windows measurement.
target_reference_profile: Intel Core i5-12400F + NVIDIA RTX 3060 12GB + 16GB RAM + Windows 11 Pro
